claims: Transfuse packed red blood cells for hemodynamically significant anemia (Hgb nadir 7.7 g/dL, Hct 23.6%) in the setting of elevated lactate and cardiac output.
Continue invasive mechanical ventilation with lung-protective settings (tidal volume ~500 mL, PEEP 5 cmH2O, FiO2 40%) and titrate FiO2 to maintain SpO2 92-96%.
Continue temporary pacemaker with backup rate 50 bpm and verify atrial/ventricular sensing and stimulation thresholds.
Monitor arterial blood gases and lactate serially to assess resolution of lactic acidosis (lactate 2.8-3.5 mmol/L).
Monitor hemoglobin and hematocrit after transfusion to assess response and need for further transfusion.
Continue hemodynamic monitoring via pulmonary artery catheter and arterial line, including cardiac output and CVP trends.
Continue insulin infusion with hourly glucose monitoring to maintain glucose in target range (recent glucose 82-144 mg/dL).
Continue vasoactive support with phenylephrine infusion and titrate to maintain MAP ≥65 mmHg.
Continue analgesia with morphine and acetaminophen as needed for moderate pain, reassessing pain scores.
Perform daily spontaneous awakening and breathing trials assessment to evaluate readiness for weaning from mechanical ventilation.
